verdict.rationale: Plausible documents HTTP APIs, including the Stats API's /api/v2/query endpoint and the Events API, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 on all of them. Because an analytics SaaS with public APIs could plausibly publish such a spec, the axis applies and the lack of evidence yields 'none'.
